'Mayonaka Heart Tune 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, 2027 Debut
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Masakuni Igarashi's Mayonaka Heart Tune (Tune In to the Midnight Heart) manga revealed an additional cast pair and a second teaser visual (pictured) for the second season on Saturday. The new season will premiere in 2027. Voice actresses Ami Koshimizu (Ookami to Koushinryou) and Kaede Hondo (Majo no Tabitabi) are joining the cast as Riina Yamabuki and Mito Yamabuki, respectively.
